offering_description.value: Provides payment, information processing and banking services to businesses, mainly freight bill payment and audit for shippers, utility bill payment and expense management, and deposit and payment services through its bank subsidiary. Serves corporate accounts and their suppliers, and earns fees for processing and banking services.

primary_services.value: freight payment and audit; utility bill payment and expense management; payment processing; bank deposit and lending services

customer_segment.value: B2B: shippers, manufacturers, retailers, utilities and corporate accounts paying suppliers and carriers

end_markets.value: transportation and logistics; utilities; manufacturing; retail; banking and payments

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for freight payment, audit and utility bill processing; transaction or usage fees: fees per payment or transaction processed; interest or premiums: net interest income from deposits and loans at its bank subsidiary
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: service provider: processes freight, utility and other payments for corporate clients; software / platform: information systems and online portals used by clients to manage payments and invoices; financial intermediary: bank subsidiary taking deposits and making loans to business clients
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US national: clients and operations across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: freight payment, utility payment and bank services sharing corporate payment technology and clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling to corporate clients; online: web portals for clients to manage payments and invoices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: bank holding company and state-chartered bank overseen by Federal Reserve and Missouri banking regulators
